title: Understanding MSE on Training Data
text: When you remove a feature from a model, it can affect the model's ability to fit the training data. Consider how this might impact the Mean Squared Error (MSE) on the training data.

title: Effect of Removing a Feature
text: Removing a feature can lead to a simpler model. Think about how this simplification might affect the model's performance on the training data.

title: Impact on Training MSE
text: If a feature is removed, the model might not fit the training data as closely. What could be a possible effect on the MSE on the training data?
